headline: Recommended approval of projects at 45 Howard Street, 124-126 North Avenue, and 227 North Champlain Street.
summary: The board reviewed three zoning applications. It recommended approval of an addition at 45 Howard Street (ZP-26-28), a new four-story 16 unit residential building at 124-126 North Avenue (ZP-26-216), and an accessory dwelling unit at 227 North Champlain Street (ZP-26-293).
decisions: Recommended approval of the application as revised for ZP-26-28 at 45 Howard Street, vote 4-0.
Recommended approval of ZP-26-216 at 124-126 North Avenue, including staff report items, vote 5-0.
Recommended approval of ZP-26-293 at 227 North Champlain Street, vote 4-0.

BURLINGTON DESIGN ADVISORY BOARD 
Tuesday, July 14, 2026, 3:00 PM 
MINUTES 
 
 Hybrid & In Person (at 645 Pine Street) Meeting 
 
Board Members Present: Ron Wanamaker, Jay White, Gabe Stadecker, Emily Morse, and Ricky 
Martin 
Board Members Absent: None  
Staff Members Present: Mary O’Neil 
 
Agenda 
 
Session I – 3:00 PM – 3:30 PM 
 
ZP-26-28; 45 Howard Street (RM, Ward 5) Sarah Schiesser / Thomas Wironen / 
Robert Hale 
Proposed construction of an addition to the west side of existing single-family home. 
Original historic home will be repainted and repaired in kind. (Project Manager, Mary 
O’Neil) 
Gabe Stadecker recused, as he is applicant’s architect and presenting. 
 
Motion by Ricky Martin:  In the matter of ZP-26-28, I move we recommend approval of 
the application as revised. 
2nd – Emily Morse 
Vote 4-0 
Motion carries. 
 
Session II – 3:30 PM – 4:00 PM 
 
ZP-26-216; 124-126 North Avenue (RC, Ward 2) Katie Chaucer / Michael Chaucer 
Proposed demolition of existing duplex to construct a new four-story 16 unit residential 
building. (Project Manager, Mary O’Neil) 
Michael Chaucer and Roen Percy Adams present. 
 
Motion by Emily Morse:  In the matter of ZP-26-216, I move we recommend approval, 
including all the items noted in the staff report.  The Board also recommends exploration of 
whether a continuous parapet is possible, given the regulation for a break in the elevation. 
Floor plans and elevations need to match. 
2nd – Jay White. 
Vote 5-0.  
Motion carries.
Session III – 4:00 PM – 4:30 PM 
 
ZP-26-293; 227 North Champlain Street (RM, Ward 2) Katherine Lasko / Tyler Bolles 
Proposed replacement of an existing garage with a two-story Accessory Dwelling Unit 
(ADU) consisting of a studio/hobby space with additional living space. (Project Manager, 
Mary O’Neil) 
Tyler Bolles and Kate Lasko, owners, present. 
Emily Morse recused, as she represents owners as project designer. 
 
Motion by Ricky Martin:  In the matter of ZP-26-293, I move we recommend approval.   
2nd – Gabe Stadecker. 
Vote 4-0. 
Motion carries. 
 
 
 
 
Meeting adjourned 4:40 p.m.
